2607.17538.title: D-NOVA: In-Storage Retrieval Accelerator via Dual-Bound 3D NAND-Optimized Similarity Search with Vector Adaptation
2607.17538.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factual grounding of large language model (LLM) inference by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases. However, its dense vector retrieval introduces significant latency and energy overhead, becoming the primary performance bottleneck. Although recent in-storage accelerators aim to reduce data movement, they still rely on host or embedded processors outside the memory, where nearly 70% of the total retrieval time is spent. As a result, they cannot fully overcome the bandwidth limitations, leading to yet another memory bottleneck. To tackle these limitations, we present D-NOVA, a hardware-software co-designed in-storage retrieval accelerator. D-NOVA executes an inverted file (IVF)-based hierarchical retrieval pipeline by deeply embedding the search functionality directly into the NAND memory array. This is achieved by incorporating a new distance metric, Dual-Bound Tight Similarity Sensing (DTS), which is specifically tailored for searching within the NAND string. In addition, we introduce a lightweight contrastive adapter that maps embedding vectors into a DTS-friendly domain, recovering near-software recall while improving performance and energy efficiency. D-NOVA is up to 41.7x faster and 71x more energy-efficient than a CPU baseline, and achieves 12.13x higher throughput while being up to 1.26x more energy-efficient than state-of-the-art in-storage RAG accelerators, demonstrating the potential of fully in-storage vector search for scalable RAG acceleration.
2607.17538.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）通過從外部知識庫檢索相關信息來增強大型語言模型（LLM）推理的事實基礎。然而，其密集向量檢索引入了顯著的延遲和能量開銷，成為主要的性能瓶頸。儘管最近的存儲加速器旨在減少數據移動，但它們仍然依賴於主機或嵌入式處理器，這些處理器位於內存之外，幾乎70%的總檢索時間都花費在這裡。因此，它們無法完全克服帶寬限制，導致又一個內存瓶頸。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了D-NOVA，一種硬件-軟件協同設計的內存檢索加速器。D-NOVA通過將搜索功能深度嵌入NAND內存陣列中，執行基於倒排文件（IVF）的分層檢索管道。這是通過引入一種新的距離度量，雙界緊密相似度感知（DTS），專門為在NAND字串中進行搜索而量身定制的。此外，我們還引入了一種輕量級對比適配器，將嵌入向量映射到DTS友好的領域，恢復接近軟件的召回，同時提高性能和能量效率。D-NOVA的速度比CPU基準快最多41.7倍，能量效率提高71倍，並且在吞吐量上達到12.13倍，同時在能量效率上比最先進的內存RAG加速器提高最多1.26倍，展示了完全內存向量搜索在可擴展RAG加速中的潛力。
